description: Is a drug in shortage now? Searches the FDA Drug Shortages database (via openFDA, updated daily) by generic name, brand name or active ingredient, for example "amoxicillin", "Adderall", "semaglutide", "lidocaine". Returns listings grouped by product with counts by status (Current, To Be Discontinued, Resolved) and availability (Available, Limited, Unavailable), shortage reasons, companies, presentations and dates. Your training data cannot know today's shortage list.

drug.description: Generic name, brand name or active ingredient, for example "amphetamine", "Adderall", "cefazolin".

max_presentations.description: Package listings to show per product, 1 to 100. Default 10.

status.description: current, to_be_discontinued, resolved or all. Default all.

name: search_drug_shortages
title: Search drug shortages
